customMethods.name: applyCell
resolveOutScan
customMethods.script:
code = self.view.custom.outScan
	if not code:
		return
	r = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getByName(code)
	if r:
		self.view.custom.activeLotId = r.get("Id")
		self.view.custom.activeLotName = r.get("LotName")
		self.view.custom.shotCount = r.get("PieceCount")
		self.view.custom.lotPieceCount = r.get("PieceCount")
		self.view.custom.scrapLines = []
		self.refreshScrapUi()
	else:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("LOT not found", "No LOT matches '%s'." % code, "warning")

customMethods.name: refreshScrapUi
customMethods.script:
# Rebuild every derived scrap prop in ONE pass from the two sources of truth
	# (defectCodeTiles = the catalog, scrapLines = what the operator has entered).
	m = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.buildScrapEntryModel(self.view.custom.defectCodeTiles, self.view.custom.scrapLines, self.view.custom.scrapShowAll)
	self.view.custom.scrapTiles = m["tiles"]
	self.view.custom.scrapLineRows = m["lines"]
	self.view.custom.scrapTotal = m["total"]
	self.view.custom.scrapMoreCount = m["moreCount"]
	lp = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.lotPieceCount)
	self.view.custom.shotCount = None if lp is None else max(0, lp - m["total"])

customMethods.name: changeScrap
customMethods.script:
# One entry point for every scrap interaction: tile tap / -/+ stepper
	# (payload.delta) and typed qty or remove (payload.quantity). Lines are
	# keyed by defectCodeId, so a repeat tap counts up instead of duplicating.
	if not self.view.custom.activeLotId:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No LOT", "Scan or select a LOT before recording scrap.", "warning")
		return
	lp = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.lotPieceCount)
	res = BlueRidge.Quality.DefectCode.applyScrapChange(self.view.custom.scrapLines, payload.get("defectCodeId"), payload.get("delta"), payload.get("quantity"), lp)
	self.view.custom.scrapLines = res["lines"]
	if res["clamped"]:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Scrap capped", "Scrap cannot exceed the LOT's %s pieces." % lp, "warning")
	self.refreshScrapUi()

customMethods.name: submitTrimOut
customMethods.script:
lotId = self.view.custom.activeLotId
	if lotId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("No LOT", "Scan or select a LOT before recording Trim OUT.", "warning")
		return
	operationTemplateId = BlueRidge.Parts.OperationTemplate.getActiveTemplateIdForLot(lotId, "TrimOut")
	if operationTemplateId is None:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Template missing", "No active 'TrimOut' operation template is published.", "error")
		return
	rows = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(self.view.custom.scrapLines) or []
	scrapLines = []
	total = 0
	for r in rows:
		r = r or {}
		d = r.get("defectCodeId")
		q = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(r.get("quantity"))
		if d is None and not q:
			continue  # skip a blank row
		if not q or q <= 0 or d is None:
			BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Incomplete scrap line", "Each scrap line needs a reason and a positive quantity.", "warning")
			return
		scrapLines.append({"defectCodeId": d, "quantity": q})
		total += q
	lp = BlueRidge.Common.Util.toIntOrNone(self.view.custom.lotPieceCount) or 0
	if total > lp:
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Too much scrap", "Scrap (%d) exceeds the LOT's pieces (%d)." % (total, lp), "warning")
		return
	good = max(0, lp - total)
	data = {
		"parentLotId": lotId,
		"operationTemplateId": operationTemplateId,
		"shotCount": good,
		"scrapLines": scrapLines,
		"destinationCellLocationId": None,
		"sourceLocationId": self.session.custom.terminal.zoneLocationId,
	}
	res = BlueRidge.Workorder.TrimOut.record(data, self.session.custom.appUserId, (self.session.custom.terminal.terminalLocationId if self.session.custom.terminal else None))
	BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "Trim OUT recorded")
	if res.get("Status"):
		self.view.custom.activeLotId = None
		self.view.custom.activeLotName = None
		self.view.custom.outScan = ""
		self.view.custom.shotCount = None
		self.view.custom.lotPieceCount = None
		self.view.custom.scrapLines = []
		self.view.custom.refreshToken = (self.view.custom.refreshToken or 0) + 1
		self.refreshScrapUi()

customMethods.name: startup
customMethods.script:
# Operator gate: no logged-in operator -> open the initials popup OVER this screen.
	# Non-blocking: the page still populates behind the modal, and session.custom is
	# reactive, so the operator label/mutations pick up the user with no re-populate.
	if not self.session.custom.appUserId:
		system.perspective.openPopup("mpp-initials", "BlueRidge/Components/Popups/InitialsEntry", params={"popupId": "mpp-initials"}, modal=True, showCloseIcon=False, overlayDismiss=False)
	self.refreshScrapUi()

messageHandlers.script:

try:

	# route-driven queues hold the LOT pending at TrimIn and it never reaches Machining IN.
	BlueRidge.Workorder.ProductionEvent.recordTrimInCheckpoint(payload.get("lotId"), self.session.custom.appUserId, termId)
